options.name: --url
options.description: URL to fetch the repository metadata from

options.name: --offlinedata
options.description: Use the data from the extrepo-offline-data package

options.name: --mirror
options.description: Use this mirror of the repository (enable, update)

suggestions.name: auto
suggestions.description: The .onion URL if there is one, else tunnel through tor

suggestions.name: onion
suggestions.description: Use the .onion URL; fail if there is none

suggestions.name: tunnel
suggestions.description: Tunnel the regular URL through tor

suggestions.name: if-onion
suggestions.description: The .onion URL if there is one, else no tor

subcommands.name: search
subcommands.description: Search repositories by name, description or URL (a regex)

subcommands.name: enable
subcommands.description: Enable a repository (re-enables a disabled one without updating it)

subcommands.name: disable
subcommands.description: Disable a repository (adds Enabled: no to its apt sources)

subcommands.name: update
subcommands.description: Rewrite a repository's apt sources and keyring from the current metadata (all, without a name)
